feature_policy.funding: native BTC funding observed at decision time; no forward fill; no annualization in stored feed
feature_policy.basis: UBTC/USDC spot versus BTC/USDC perp; mark both legs at matched or prior observations only
feature_policy.execution: observed bid/ask and depth at decision time; reject windows without required history
feature_policy.identity: spot token is non-canonical Unit Bitcoin (UBTC), never relabel as native BTC

split_policy.boundary_windows: purge every holding window intersecting a split boundary

purge_policy.rule: purge a full candidate holding horizon on either side of every boundary

embargo_policy.rule: no outcome window may overlap the embargo

cost_assumptions.funding: native published funding applied only to simulated open perp quantity at eligible event time
cost_assumptions.basis: realized entry-to-exit spot/perp price changes included jointly in outcome residual
cost_assumptions.reserve: risk admission buffer, not a realized cost or cash debit
cost_assumptions.cash_scope: isolated experiment; never added to canonical Carry or Trend capital

fee_assumptions.source: conservative configured PAPER estimates; public base schedule only; no account-specific tier or referral verified
fee_assumptions.execution_counted_once: commission as fee; spread/depth through simulated fill price

slippage_assumptions.fallback: reject observation when captured depth is missing or insufficient
slippage_assumptions.double_count_rule: never debit static slippage again when fill price already walks book

impact_assumptions.latency: record capture and receive clocks; do not claim queue or latency reconstruction
impact_assumptions.missing_history: no synthetic liquidity; mark evidence insufficient

parameter_space.joint_residual: max(0, model_net_before_reserve_at_entry - realized_net_after_all_observed_costs_and_basis), expressed as fraction of total allocated cash

acceptance_rules.net_after_reserve: positive lower 95% confidence bound in validation and final holdout after every preregistered stress
acceptance_rules.drawdown: no more than 10% of total allocated cash and must improve or match control
acceptance_rules.operations: zero unhedged, missing-funding, double-credit, minimum-size, or margin-limit violations
acceptance_rules.adoption: no adoption without a separately frozen candidate and genuinely forward holdout

scenarios: funding forecast shortfall and adverse basis measured jointly at 97.5th percentile
UBTC versus BTC basis shock of -5%
one-sided missing or insufficient depth: reject entry and evaluate safe close behavior
funding negative, delayed, duplicated, and resumed after restart

holdout_policy.close_rule: fixed calendar horizon, exit costs included, no extension to amortize fees
holdout_policy.forward_holdout: after candidate freeze, first 10 fully matured non-overlapping windows per horizon, sealed before result access
holdout_policy.retuning_after_holdout: invalidates that holdout; register a new experiment and await new future data

sample_sufficiency_policy.window_spacing: at least the candidate holding horizon; overlapping hourly bars do not count as independent observations

candidate_selection_rule: among candidates passing all pre-registered data, net-after-reserve, drawdown and cost-stress gates, select the one with the greatest net return on total allocated cash; ties select lower drawdown, then shorter horizon; if none pass, retain the current 2% reserve and 30-day ceiling

promotion_gates.profitability_evidence: positive lower 95% confidence bound on total-cash net after reserve and preregistered stress in an untouched forward holdout
promotion_gates.technical_evidence: all paper accounting and recovery invariants pass; two isolated paper cycles survive restart
promotion_gates.maturity: at least 30 development and 10 untouched forward completed non-overlapping windows for each candidate horizon across at least 3 regimes
promotion_gates.risk: no margin, unhedged, accounting, data-integrity, or double-counting violation
promotion_gates.trend_isolation: Trend allocation, rules, runtime state and service remain unchanged
